# Partial Analysis

## Headline Insight

The document's core claim needs quantification to be testable.

## Theory Collisions

Efficiency vs. completeness is a classic tension. The document doesn't resolve it.

## Discovery vs. Proof

The need for verifiable output is discovered but not proven to be achievable with the given constraints.

## Density-Checked Falsification

The efficiency claim can be falsified by any system meeting the constraints that runs arbitrarily slowly.

## Coherence Signals

STRONG: Efficiency and verifiability both require explicit metrics.
